mapper.select: WITH temp AS ( SELECT sum(H001A) AS H001A FROM ovie_web.areas a ,ovie_web.economico_mza e WHERE a.gid=#{id} AND ST_Intersects(a.the_geom,e.the_geom) ) SELECT trunc((H001A/sum(pobtot))*100,2) FROM ovie_web.areas a ,ovie_web.sociodemografico_mza p,temp WHERE a.gid=#{id} AND ST_Intersects(a.the_geom,p.the_geom) GROUP by H001A
